reviews.text: Sar Stone was great from beggining to end.  I have talked to a lot of contractors and something always goes wrong.  They were professional from beginning to end.  They rehabbed my house from A- Z literally.  A 5 bedroom 3 bath house.  I would definitely recommend them for anyone doing rehab/construction on their home.

Sar Stone did some work on my primary residence and we were thrilled with the outcome. Great pricing, amazing work and very professional - everything you could ask for from a construction group. Highly recommend them for anyone looking to do some work around the house

Excellent work. Hired to remodel my grandparents living room. Really liked that they explained everything about the job first to make sure my grandparents were comfortable and afterwards my grandparents were very happy with the work that was done. Yes we would recommend Sar Stone
